propositions: Focused prerequisite-consistency criterion must run only when PlanRelationSnapshot preload succeeds and contains readable direct prerequisite relations, evaluated exactly once per canonical ID in stable lexicographic order.

Finder and verifier must emit closed-schema dispositions (consistent|finding|indeterminate with reason codes) and preserve general criterion isolation by forbidding prerequisite IDs and plan text from general finder/verifier/coach inputs.

Finding identity for prerequisite-scoped results must use canonical four-field UTF-8 length-prefixed encoding (version, text, criteria, prerequisite_id) with SHA-256 hash; legacy pipe-delimited encoding preserved byte-for-byte for non-prerequisite findings.

Any indeterminate prerequisite coverage record forces unsigned top-level INDETERMINATE verdict while retaining all DET blockers visible in the blocking array; concurrent non-DET blockers move to indeterminate with reason=prerequisite-coverage-indeterminate.
Focused Pass-2 verifier attribution veto (yes|no|na) is optional plan-review-only field added only to plan_review_verification model; code-review and kernel verification contracts remain unchanged.

Batching must never split subject plan or prerequisite block text; focused and general verification index domains are independently reshaped and concatenated only after both are decided, preventing domain shift.
